# DexJoCo: Reproduction of Pi0.5, ROCm JAX, and 11 tasks

DexJoCo is a dexterous manipulation benchmark based on MuJoCo, covering 11 single-arm, dual-arm, tool usage, and long-time-series tasks. In this chapter, the simulator and OpenPI/Pi0.5 are separated into two isolated environments, connected via WebSocket［network communication protocol］, to perform native AMD JAX［AMD platform high-performance array computing framework］ inference, data conversion, training, and closed-loop video evaluation.

## Outputs and Tasks of This Chapter

| Task | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `click_mouse`, `fold_glasses`, `hammer_nail`, `pick_bucket`, `pinch_tongs`, `water_plant` | Single-arm or tool manipulation |
| `bimanual_assembly`, `bimanual_hanoi`, `bimanual_microwave_cook`, `bimanual_photograph`, `bimanual_unlock_ipad` | Dual-arm coordination and long-time-series operations |

The single-arm policy outputs 22-dimensional actions, while the dual-arm policy outputs 44-dimensional actions. Each task is generated by the completion conditions of the official environment `success`, including the relationship between target objects, tool states, or the final state of the task. The results per round include the task name, random seed, number of steps, success fields, and video.

Record the source code version after installation:

```bash
git -C "$SRC_ROOT/dexjoco" rev-parse HEAD
```

## 1. Download source code, data, and model

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT"
git clone https://github.com/brave-eai/dexjoco.git
cd dexjoco

conda env create -f environment-dexjoco.yaml
conda activate dexjoco
```

LeRobot［Robot Learning Data Framework］ data and Pi0.5 model:

```bash
hf download DexJoCo/DexJoCo-Datasets-LeRobot \
  --repo-type dataset \
  --local-dir "$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-lerobot"

hf download DexJoCo/DexJoCo-Pi05 \
  --include 'pi05_dexjoco_multi_task/**' \
  --local-dir "$MODEL_ROOT/dexjoco-pi05"
```

Downloading only the multi-task model saves space. Single-task and `rand_full` visual randomization weights are downloaded as needed.

## 2. Simulator Environment and 11 Task Check

```bash
export MUJOCO_GL=egl
python scripts/amd_rocm_smoke.py \
  --output "$RUN_ROOT/dexjoco/smoke_11_tasks"
```

The output should include `smoke_report.json` and 11 MP4 files of tasks. What is confirmed here are the environment, action interface, and rendering chain; policy evaluation will be completed in subsequent steps.

## 3. Native ROCm JAX Environment Without Docker

Python 3.12 environment is separated from the Python 3.11 environment of the simulator:

```bash
export ROCM_JAX010_ENV="$ENV_ROOT/openpi-amd-jax010"
python3.12 -m venv "$ROCM_JAX010_ENV"
export PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1

"$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" -m pip install --upgrade pip
"$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" -m pip install \
  --index-url https://repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-multi-arch/ \
  'rocm[libraries,device-gfx1151]==7.14.0'
"$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" -m pip install \
  --index-url https://repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-multi-arch/ \
  'jax_rocm7_plugin==0.10.0+rocm7.14.0' \
  'jax_rocm7_pjrt==0.10.0+rocm7.14.0'
"$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" -m pip install 'jax==0.10.0' 'jaxlib==0.10.0'
```

Then execute the matrix pre-check for JAX［high-performance array computing framework］ in README_10. Do not install different ROCm JAX［AMD platform JAX runtime stack］ versions in the same environment.

## 4. Data Collection and Replay

Interactive capture teaching successful:

```bash
conda activate dexjoco
python scripts/record_demos_zarr.py \
  --exp_name=water_plant \
  --successes_needed=20 \
  --randomize=True \
  --out_dir="$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-raw/water_plant"
```

Playback and review the initial state, actions, and video:

```bash
python scripts/replay_demos_zarr.py \
  --exp_name=water_plant \
  --input_dir="$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-raw/water_plant" \
  --out_dir="$RUN_ROOT/dexjoco/replay/water_plant" \
  --randomize=True \
  --restore_state=True
```

## 5. Convert to LeRobot data

```bash
bash dexjoco-data-converter/install.bash
conda activate dexjoco-dc

dexjoco-dc-single-lerobot \
  --input "$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-raw/water_plant" \
  --output "$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-lerobot-local/water_plant" \
  --language-instruction 'Grasp the watering can and apply water to the plant.' \
  --selected-data-yaml '{action: action_rotvec, state: state, cameras: {front: front, wrist: wrist}}' \
  --slice-yaml '{state: [null, 23]}'
```

The single-arm policy uses a 22-dimensional action, while the dual-arm version uses a 44-dimensional rotation vector action; the simulator wrapper is responsible for converting it into an internal quaternion action. After conversion, check the episode [round] boundaries, camera frames, state dimension, and action dimension.

## 6. Pi0.5 Training

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT/dexjoco/openpi"
bash install.bash
```

Complete in order before training:

1. In `openpi/config.yaml`, point `dataset_root` to `$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-lerobot`, and have `pretrained_model_path`, `pretrained_model_action_dim_44_path`, and `ckpts_root` point to the actual checkpoint directory;
2. The two-armed task runs `convert_to_action_dim_44_model.py`;
3. Run `compute_norm_stats.py` to generate normalized statistics;
4. Start single-task or multi-task training using `scripts/train.py`.

```bash
export DEXJOCO_CONFIG=multi_task

JAX_PLATFORMS=rocm \
XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false \
  "$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" scripts/compute_norm_stats.py "$DEXJOCO_CONFIG"

JAX_PLATFORMS=rocm \
XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false \
  "$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" scripts/train.py "$DEXJOCO_CONFIG" \
  --exp-name=dexjoco_pi05_amd
```

`multi_task` reads data from three cameras and multiple tasks, and uses a 44-dimensional dual-arm motion. The single-task configuration name is the same as the task name, such as `water_plant`, `hammer_nail`, `fold_glasses`, and `bimanual_hanoi`; the full configuration can be listed using the following command:

```bash
rg 'name="' src/openpi/training/dexjoco_configs.py
```

In the official documentation, single-arm LoRA［low-rank adaptation fine-tuning］ is typically trained with 30k steps［training steps］, while dual-arm/multi-task training requires 60k steps［training steps］. The local number of steps should be determined jointly by the validation set and closed-loop evaluation.

## 7.11 Formal Evaluation of Tasks

Public adaptation script:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ethan-Chen-plus/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite.git \
  "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite"

DEXJOCO_ROOT="$SRC_ROOT/dexjoco" \
CHECKPOINT="$MODEL_ROOT/dexjoco-pi05/pi05_dexjoco_multi_task" \
OPENPI_PYTHON="$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" \
DEXJOCO_EVAL="$CONDA_PREFIX/bin/dexjoco-openpi-eval" \
OUT="$RUN_ROOT/dexjoco/pi05_multitask_seed0" \
  bash "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite/scripts/run_dexjoco_pi05_multitask_eval.sh"
```

The script starts the matching policy service for each task, fixes the seed to 0, one round per task, and saves the results and video. Our results under the same protocol are `5/11`.

When searching for a reproductionable success process for failed tasks, fix the search seed [random seed] to 1–10, and stop after the first success:

```bash
DEXJOCO_ROOT="$SRC_ROOT/dexjoco" \
CHECKPOINT="$MODEL_ROOT/dexjoco-pi05/pi05_dexjoco_multi_task" \
OPENPI_PYTHON="$ROCM_JAX010_ENV/bin/python" \
BASE_OUT="$RUN_ROOT/dexjoco/pi05_multitask_seed0" \
OUT="$RUN_ROOT/dexjoco/pi05_multitask_recovery" \
  python "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite/scripts/run_dexjoco_pi05_multitask_recovery.py"
```

This success case file covers 10/11 tasks to help with learning the action process; the official seed [random seed] 0 result is still retained separately.

## 8. The Most Critical Interface in Migration

| Layer | AMD Processing |
| --- | --- |
| MuJoCo Simulator | Python 3.11, NumPy 1.26, EGL［window-free graphics rendering interface］ |
| OpenPI | Python 3.12, ROCm JAX［AMD platform JAX runtime stack］ 0.10 |
| Process Connection | WebSocket［network communication protocol］ policy service |
| Checkpoint | Orbax［JAX checkpoint system］ recovery compatible with both old and new metadata objects |
| State Input | Expanded to 46 dimensions as required by the model, then sliced according to configuration |
| Action | 22/44-dimensional rotation vector converted to a simulator quaternion action |

Three-env isolation is the core of reproduction stability: the simulator, data converter, and OpenPI do not share a common dependency set.

## 9. Video Examples

[ Full video of the two-arm Hanoi tower ](https://ethan-chen-plus.github.io/amd-physical-ai-showcase/assets/videos/dexjoco/recovery/bimanual-hanoi.mp4) is 47.6 seconds long, featuring an external perspective and left/right wrist views. All cameras were captured during the same simulation cycle, and the video results are tied to successful marks in that round.
